nodes.name: Hypothesis / Pilot study
nodes.description: A small-scale or theoretical investigation used to test feasibility or generate hypotheses, not designed for definitive conclusions.

nodes.name: Systematic review
nodes.description: A structured synthesis of multiple studies on a defined question using a reproducible methodology to identify, evaluate, and summarize available evidence.

nodes.name: Controlled experiment
nodes.description: A laboratory or field experiment with defined conditions and a control group, designed to isolate the effect of a specific variable.

nodes.name: Prospective observational
nodes.description: A study that follows participants forward in time to observe outcomes without experimental manipulation.

nodes.name: Controlled crossover trial
nodes.description: A study in which participants receive both intervention and control conditions in sequence, serving as their own controls.

nodes.name: Controlled clinical trial
nodes.description: A clinical study with a control group used to evaluate the effect of a therapeutic intervention in a patient population.

nodes.name: Controlled trial
nodes.description: A study comparing outcomes between intervention and control groups without full randomisation of participants.

nodes.name: Meta-analysis
nodes.description: A statistical technique that combines results from multiple independent studies to produce a single pooled estimate of effect size.
